title: Maximum number of storeys
text: C3.2.1 Building height complies with Table 3.2a. Table 3.2a Maximum building heights, maximum number of storeys: R2-R35 2; R40-R60 3; R80, R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR 4.

replaces.note: Part B had no storey limit; 2 storeys new for R2-R25
wall height and roof-type metrics deleted

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Register ch3-044 (one row for all bands in Chapter 3). proposal.storeys is used (application form); building.storeys is the same count from the elevations. R100-SL has a separate rule (minimum two, maximum four storeys per Table 2.10a).
